  008 ­ RECOMMENDING CITY COUNCIL APPROVE ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT 2021­0052,
  THEREBY AMENDING SECTION 18.40.070 AND ADDING SECTION 18.40.025 OF THE
  HAWAIIAN GARDENS MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING TWO­UNIT PROJECTS AND
  DETERMINE THE PROJECT IS EXEMPT PURSUANT TO SECTION 15061(B)(3) OF THE
  CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA).

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

Assistant City Attorney Patrick Donegan briefly mentioned about the upcoming joint meeting with City
Council to discuss the Draft Housing Element Update. Patrick introduced Kelly Associates as consultant
that assists staff with the update process.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Vice Chair Anna Rodriguez stated that she’s happy to see development activities throughout the City.
Ms. Rodriguez asked about the status of a private 9­unit Villa at the Casino.

Commissioner Ana Navarro inquired about construction projects at 7­Eleven, Holiday Inn Express Hotel,
hydrogen station at the 76 gas station.
